title: SKE Bar Sour Apple Ice Prefilled Vape Pod
description: This Sour Apple Ice pod for the SKE Bar Prefilled Pod Kit delivers a punchy, tangy apple note with a clean menthol finish. The crisp fruit flavour is sharpened by its sour edge, offering a bold, refreshing vape from start to finish. Each 2ml pod is prefilled with 20mg nic salt e-liquid and uses mesh coil technology for consistent MTL performance. Please Note: These are pods ONLY and the Battery is not included.
